purpose: Provisional upstream beam-target-sieve scattering case; not a run-matched acceptance simulation

coordinate_reference.policy: Keep this closed-tested coordinate benchmark immutable; apply this case as an overlay.

setting.angle_status: 12.5 deg nominal; candidate runs need their active replay angles before run-specific comparison
setting.mispointing_status: Apply source-code default translation at 12.5 deg as a provisional starting geometry, not as a surveyed or replay-measured alignment.
setting.additional_run_adjustment_status: TBD from selected run/replay or independent alignment; never absorb beam centroid into this field.

beam.source_plane_status: Provisional: 5 cm upstream of the lab target plane; source travels along +lab Z
beam.current_weight_status: Unit event weights for the first timing/process-ID run; scale yields by measured beam current later
beam.centroid_status: Provisional values from the supplied email; confirm applicability to selected run. BPM x sign is flipped to match the stated lab convention.
beam.intrinsic_sigma_status: Obtain spot-check harp widths at the beginning of the selected pass.
beam.intrinsic_sigma_used_status: Provisional zero-width Gaussian contribution until pass-matched harp widths are supplied; raster remains enabled.
beam.time_dependence: omitted for this time-integrated first study; raster phase/correlation not modeled

target.name: Carbon 0.5%
target.composition: 99.95% carbon per TGT-RPT-22-003; remaining composition unspecified
target.thickness_status: PROVISIONAL GUESS: borrowed from the thinner of the two dummy-foil certificate thicknesses cited in TGT-RPT-22-003; not a measured Carbon 0.5% thickness.
target.effective_density_formula: reported areal density / provisional thickness; preserves the report's Carbon 0.5% areal density
target.simulation_patch_status: Oversized transport patch to contain the provisional beam distribution; not a claim about the physical foil outline

sieve.drawing: 6732-C-5681, HMS slit chamber sieve slit detail

hole_pattern.drawing_grid_center_offset_direction: toward top edge in drawing front view; sign in HMS coordinates TBD
hole_pattern.orientation_to_hms_axes: TBD; retain drawing front-view coordinates until the installed/replay view is verified

sieve.longitudinal_placement_status: PROVISIONAL physical plate center at the established 168 cm analysis plane; replace if a survey/drawing gives a different reference
sieve.hole_positions_drawing_to_hms: PROVISIONAL: drawing horizontal maps to HMS x and drawing vertical maps to HMS y; vertical offset points toward drawing top

q1_entrance.source: Hall C Standard Equipment Manual, HMS Q1 magnet parameters
q1_entrance.scoring_plane_status: PROVISIONAL: 0.1 cm downstream of the sieve downstream face; used as the Q1 entrance scoring aperture because its surveyed longitudinal location is not specified in this case
q1_entrance.aperture_status: Sensitive scoring aperture uses the documented Q1 vacuum-vessel inner radius; not a magnetic acceptance boundary and no Q1 field is modeled

scoring.plane: immediately downstream of sieve material / at Q1 entrance
scoring.scope_limit: No claim of passage through HMS magnet acceptance or detector-based electron cuts without downstream transport and detector response.
